sections.section: RULE - Directorate of Archaeology and Museums Balochistan (Bps-1 to Bps-15) Service Rules 2010
sections.description:
DIRECTORATE OF ARCHAEOLOGY AND MUSEUMS BALOCHISTAN (BPS-1 TO BPS-15)
SERVICE RULES, 2010
DIRECTORATE OF ARCHAEOLOGY AND MUSEUMS BALOCHISTAN (BPS-1 TO BPS-15)
SERVICE RULES, 2010
(Insertion of New
Entries in the Appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 6th May, 2013]
No.
S.O(R-II)(12))23/2013-S&G.AD/846-900, dated 6-6-2013.--- In exercise of the
powers conferred by Section 25 of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act
No. IX of 1974), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following
amendments in the Directorate of Archaeology and Museums Balochistan (BPS-1 to
BPS-115) Service Rules, 2010, namely:-
In the aforesaid
rules, in the appendix,-
(1) after S. Nos. 3, 4 and 6 the
following new entries shall be inserted:-
3-A.
Surveyor (BPS-11)
(a) Three Years Diploma of
Associate Engineers in the relevant field from a recognized University /
Institute; and
(b) Surveying Competency
Certificate from a recognized Institute.
By initial recruitment
4-A.
Photo-grapher (BPS-8)
(a) Higher Secondary School
Certificate from a recognized Board.
(b) basic knowledge of computer
for processes of photography; and
(c) having two years experience
in the relevant field.
By initial recruitment
6-A.
Generator Operator (BPS-5)
(a) Secondary School
Certificate from a recognized Board / Institute; and
(b) T.T.C. Diploma from a
recognized Institute.
By initial recruitment.
(2) after S. No. 14, the
following new entry shall be added:--
15.
Guide (BPS-1)
Literate
By initial recruitment.
